commission.teyvatdelight.welcome.descrip: Katheryne of the Adventurers’ Guild has invited you to join.
commission.teyvatdelight.welcome.introdu:
"Welcome to the Adventurers’ Guild. I have been observing you for quite some time."
......
"I can see in you the potential to stand alongside the adventurers of legend."
......
"Without further ado, allow me to give our newest adventurer an introduction..."
"Rest assured, the Guild charges no membership fees, nor does it force adventurers to fulfill any obligations."
"In other words, joining the Guild has only benefits and no drawbacks."
......
"Then allow me to formally welcome you, rising star of adventure!"
......
"That will be all for today. I expect we will see each other often."
"Keep striving, adventurer. Ad astra abyssosque!"

item.teyvatdelight.jam.desc: A gel made by simmering fruit with sugar. Even a small amount can easily awaken tired taste buds.
item.teyvatdelight.butter.desc: A dairy product made by rapidly churning milk. An essential ingredient for making delicious pastries.
item.teyvatdelight.cheese.desc: A dairy product made by concentrating and fermenting milk. It provides energy while opening endless culinary possibilities.
item.teyvatdelight.cream.desc: Milk fat separated from milk. Used in moderation, it can lend even ordinary ingredients a rich, sweet aroma.
item.teyvatdelight.sunsettia.desc: A gift of nature found throughout Teyvat, now brought to another world. This plump fruit glows with the beauty of sunset and carries a strangely sweet aroma that restores one's spirits.
item.teyvatdelight.pinecone.desc: A plump seed rich in oil. It will not grow into a towering tree inside a squirrel's stomach.
item.teyvatdelight.crab_roe.desc: A delicacy found only in female crabs. Rare and precious, crab roe gathers the crab's finest essence, though not everyone knows how to appreciate its flavor.
item.teyvatdelight.smoked_fowl.desc: Fowl that has been smoked. Its firm texture offers a distinctive culinary experience.
message.teyvatdelight.dandelion_scattere: The dandelion scattered in the wind... Maybe try a gentler touch?
item.teyvatdelight.windblume.desc:
A beautiful yet refreshing flower native to northern Mondstadt. Its clear, lasting fragrance makes it a favored perfume ingredient.
In folk tales from Dornman Port, the first Windblume was born from the song of the Lord of Wind. In ancient days, the wandering god is said to have soothed the snowbound land and turned flowing verse into blossoms. Yet the Church of Favonius does not recognize these tales as miracles. Just as anyone may pluck a string, countless ordinary people sang of freedom and resistance and made the north their home.
item.teyvatdelight.wolfhook.desc: A hooked berry that clings to wolves' fur to spread. Seeing it almost brings the sound of wolves howling through the forest to mind. It can be used as medicine, though its thorns can hurt the unwary.
item.teyvatdelight.snapdragon.desc: An herb that becomes edible after cooking. As a seasoning, it lends food a curious flavor.
item.teyvatdelight.valberry.desc: A plump, translucent berry with a sweet floral taste. Once, its sweetness and the hope of a peaceful city were the only comforts of those who watched for storms.
item.teyvatdelight.dandelion_seeds.desc:
Tiny seeds carried by the wind. Even without their traveling down, they seem to hold hope for distant places.
Dandelions symbolize freedom and an unrestrained spirit. In the land of wind, people make wine from them, a practice some scholars believe once carried deep symbolic meaning.
item.teyvatdelight.cecilia.desc: A flower as beautiful as its name. It grows only in cool, windswept heights, as difficult to reach as a wanderer's true heart.
item.teyvatdelight.raspberry.desc: Brightly colored fruit, a small delight found throughout the wilds that can ease the weariness of a journey.
item.teyvatdelight.sweet_flower.desc: A fragrant plant whose scent can guide you even in the dark. Across Teyvat, it is commonly used to make sugar.
block.teyvatdelight.pink_windblume.desc:

item.teyvatdelight.sweet_flower_seeds.de: Seeds collected while gathering Sweet Flower.
item.teyvatdelight.portable_nutrition_ba:
A special device designed by an alchemist of the Knights of Favonius.
It turns most dishes into nutrients that can be consumed in an instant.
The alchemist finds it a far more efficient way to replenish energy,
but few knights seem willing to use it...
item.teyvatdelight.wind_wings.desc:
How I wish a breeze would blow right now.
A style of wind glider. A gift bestowed in recognition and appreciation by Mondstadt.
item.teyvatdelight.empty_feather_moth.de:
A strange life-form shimmering with sacred golden light, drifting like a moth through an equally strange rift.
Legend says Empty Feather Moths were born from the wings of rebellious angels who once defied the masters of the heavens and fell to earth. Yet this does not explain why they appear in the realm of eternal stasis. Perhaps, in the eyes of a certain god, they too are worth preserving as witnesses to the punishment of sinners.
Noelle's specialty.
These thick pancakes, a Knights of Favonius afternoon-tea treat, feel as soft as clouds. Noelle's smile somehow makes them taste even sweeter.
item.teyvatdelight.fish_flavored_toast.d:
Klee's specialty.
After her bombs frightened away the fish, Klee made this toast for the fishermen under Jean's guidance. It is tasty and filling enough to keep her going all day.
item.teyvatdelight.magical_meat_sauce_pa:
Lisa's specialty.
The meat sauce has a curious color, but once you take a bite, you cannot stop. What magic did she put in it?
item.teyvatdelight.manor_pancakes.desc:
Round baked pancakes.
Once an afternoon treat at the manor, they became an everyday staple, decorated with the finest berries.
item.teyvatdelight.fishermans_toast.desc:
Toast covered in onions.
A favorite of fishermen, who pack it before spending the whole day by the river.
item.teyvatdelight.flaming_red_bolognese:
Thin pasta with a rich meat sauce.
Its bright red tomato sauce is sweet, tangy, and especially appetizing.
item.teyvatdelight.iced_wolfhook_juice.d:
A refreshing, fashionable non-alcoholic drink.
Fresh wolfhook juice, ice, and a little care give it a dreamy purple color.
item.teyvatdelight.berry_mint_drink.desc:
A refreshing, fashionable non-alcoholic drink.
This invigorating mint drink is garnished with berries and has an elegant fragrance.
item.teyvatdelight.creamy_vegetable_stew:
Meat and vegetables stewed in cream.
The thick sauce gives each warm mouthful a mellow, rich flavor.
Barbara's specialty.
Star-shaped carrots make the dish look adorable. But what is this devilishly spicy taste?
item.teyvatdelight.satisfying_salad.desc:
A platter of fresh vegetables.
A soft-boiled egg sits among boiled potatoes and fruit, making for a filling meal.
item.teyvatdelight.supreme_wisdom_life.d:
Mona's specialty.
The great astrologer's great creation is greatest of all at filling you up for remarkably little cost.
item.teyvatdelight.fried_radish_balls.de:
Fried radish balls.
Crisp outside and tender inside, they are best eaten hot. Some say the recipe came from Liyue.
item.teyvatdelight.sweet_madame.desc:
Chicken roasted with sweet flowers.
Sweet floral juices seep into the tender meat.
item.teyvatdelight.dinners_judgment.desc:
Rosaria's specialty.
The thorny, dark-looking garnish takes some effort to remove, but the chicken underneath is surprisingly delicious. Rosaria seems pleased to see your reaction.
item.teyvatdelight.sparkling_valberry_ju:
A new non-alcoholic drink.
Berries of different ripeness give this fizzy, chilled juice a lingering sweet-to-tart finish.
item.teyvatdelight.apple_cider.desc:
A refreshing, fashionable non-alcoholic drink.
It is said to help with a hangover, so guests often order one at the end of a gathering.
item.teyvatdelight.northern_smoked_chick:
Smoked fowl served with vegetables.
Northern households make this dish to welcome important guests.
item.teyvatdelight.hearty_revelry.desc:
Varka's specialty.
A large smoked chicken leg, a generous cup of apple cider, and a bold presentation all speak to his belief that battle and dinner should be enjoyed to the fullest.
item.teyvatdelight.rich_vegetable_stew.d:
A hot, hearty stew.
Chilled meat and vegetables are cut into pieces and simmered with tomato until thick. It warms you from the inside.
item.teyvatdelight.calla_lily_seafood_so:
A balanced seafood soup.
Every spoonful carries the taste of crab, while mint and calla lily lend a light freshness.
item.teyvatdelight.honey_roasted_carrots:
Meat glazed with honey sauce.
Carrots cut through the meat's richness, leaving a sweet, warming finish.
item.teyvatdelight.butter_matsutake.desc:
Pan-fried matsutake slices.
Butter gives the thin slices crisp edges and tender centers. They disappear quickly from the table.
item.teyvatdelight.cold_cut_platter.desc:
A platter piled high with meat.
Equal portions of bacon, ham, and sausage let diners set aside the argument about which is best.
item.teyvatdelight.blessed_symphony.desc:
Fischl's specialty.
The exquisite arrangement suggests a hidden meaning. Look toward Fischl while eating, and you may catch her expectant glance through her fingers.
Fried potato cakes.
A little pinecone adds texture, and jam makes them a favorite with diners of all ages.
Razor's specialty.
Carefully shaped like a wolf's paw, this simple, sweet cake shows how hard he has worked at human cooking.
item.teyvatdelight.once_upon_a_time_in_m: Once Upon a Time in Mondstadt

Diluc's specialty.
First admire the careful presentation. Then let the tender steak melt in your mouth. Who knew he could cook like this?
item.teyvatdelight.pile_em_up.desc:
A generously layered meat dish.
A Mondstadt home recipe of steak, potatoes, and cheese that became a Windblume Festival favorite.
item.teyvatdelight.crab_roe_ham_bake.des:
A luxurious baked vegetable dish.
Pink ham and green vegetables peek through its golden crust.
item.teyvatdelight.nutritious_meal_593.d:
Sucrose's specialty.
It looks like a curious alchemical creation, but Sucrose insists this nutritious meal is the result of repeated improvements. The healthy green color comes from vegetable juice in the cream... vegetable juice?
item.teyvatdelight.mushroom_pizza.desc:
A flatbread covered in mushrooms and cheese.
When hot, the cheese stretches into long strings with every bite.
item.teyvatdelight.invigorating_pizza.de:
Jean's specialty.
This pizza is as orderly as a work of art. One slice is enough to lift your spirits for another stretch of work.
A simple dish with a long history.
Its humble ingredients make a warm bowl of stew satisfying wherever you are.
item.teyvatdelight.true_barbatos_ratatou:
Venti's specialty.
Apart from the cecilia garnish, it uses the same ingredients as the ordinary dish. Taste carefully, though, and you may find a small breeze of hope.
item.teyvatdelight.holy_water.desc:
A small bottle of clear, colorless liquid.
It looks just like spring water. Is it really worth such high hopes?
item.teyvatdelight.butter_fried_fish.des:
Fish cooked slowly in butter.
Careful heat preserves the tender fish while adding a lightly browned, buttery aroma.
item.teyvatdelight.forest_dream.desc:
Albedo's specialty.
Vegetables become grass and trees in a tiny world on the plate. Follow the path to an orange castle; the tender sweetness blooms, and the white-haired prince smiles.
item.teyvatdelight.holiday_fruit_brew.de:
A colorful non-alcoholic drink.
Juices from sunsettias and wolfhooks are layered into a refreshing gradient that recalls a happy holiday. Pour in the right order!
item.teyvatdelight.adventurer_egg_burger:
A nutritious egg breakfast.
Ham and poached egg rest on toast under a rich sauce, fueling many an adventurer's journey.
Mika's specialty.
Sweet and savory layers rise like a mountain of food. Perhaps his travels taught him to make a breakfast this substantial.
item.teyvatdelight.whirlwind_meat.desc:
A popular meat dish.
Thin meat wraps around bacon and vegetables before being browned and stewed. Each slice shows a swirl of filling.
item.teyvatdelight.apple_roll.desc:
A traditional apple dessert.
Its delicate pastry is so thin that a master baker's sheet would not hide the words on a page.
item.teyvatdelight.shrimp_potato_cup.des:
An appetizing starter.
Potatoes and berries form the filling on crisp potato chips, crowned with shrimp and served with mint.
item.teyvatdelight.night_talk.desc:
Talia's specialty.
He claims a divine instruction told him to serve this golden snack, with a sly wink. Watching him wait for your reaction, you begin to wonder whose idea it really was.
item.teyvatdelight.northern_apple_stew.d:
Meat braised with apples.
Tender meat juices blend with a light fruit aroma for an unexpectedly fresh flavor.
Durin's specialty.
Imitating your cooking, Durin made his first dish. Its fruity aroma and slightly crisp edges show both his curiosity and his care.
item.teyvatdelight.good_morning_windmill:
A classic Windmill Town breakfast.
Warm sliced meat patties, fried egg, and sausage provide enough energy for a busy morning.
item.teyvatdelight.harbor_fish_burger.de:
A fish burger.
Fresh bread holds pickled fish, crisp vegetables, onion rings, and sauce. Tangy and savory, it wakes the appetite.
item.teyvatdelight.mint_bubble_gum.desc:
Soft, stretchy candy.
Two flavors mingle as you blow a bubble. Take care not to make it so large that it bursts across your face!
item.teyvatdelight.boredom_bubble_gum.de:
Lorn's specialty.
He offers candy to relieve your boredom, then produces a mirror with a mischievous grin. Your tongue has turned green; perhaps it was his boredom he meant to cure.
item.teyvatdelight.moon_pie.desc:
A traditional Mondstadt staple.
Richly flavored marinated meat stays sweet and moist inside its baked pastry. No festival is complete without it.
item.teyvatdelight.surf_pie.desc:
Eula's specialty.
The crescent shape may challenge tradition or reflect her taste for vengeance. Beneath the golden crust lies a rich, smoky filling unlike anything else in Mondstadt.

commission.teyvatdelight.eat_while_hot.d: The aroma of delicious food drifts from a camp beneath the snowy mountain, but Chef □□□ seems troubled by something...

commission.teyvatdelight.evil_roaming.de: A band of monsters is roaming the wilderness, threatening the surrounding area. Defeat them and remove the threat.
commission.teyvatdelight.pursuing_outlaw: A band of outlaws has arrived nearby and threatens the safety of the region. Defeat them.
commission.teyvatdelight.for_the_calamit: "For the Calamity Godfather..." The pillagers seem to be plotting something dangerous. Put an end to their troublemaking!
commission.teyvatdelight.drink_time.desc: □□ seems to have made progress with his research. What sort of drink has he created...?
commission.teyvatdelight.a_strange_time_: The fisherman □□ seems busy with something...
commission.teyvatdelight.measure_world.d: A scholar who wishes to "measure the world" seems to have reached an impasse...
Jafar, a scholar who loves good food, is once again studying the art of "eating"...
commission.teyvatdelight.archery_demonst: □□ of Watatsumi Island seems troubled by their archery skills...
commission.teyvatdelight.the_taste_of_fi: The "Provisional Head Priestess of Asase Shrine," □□, seems worried about something...
Naganohara Fireworks seems to have a new kind of firework...
commission.teyvatdelight.inazuma_fashion: Mio, the owner of "Ogura Textiles & Kimonos," seems troubled...
commission.teyvatdelight.wine_has_its_ow: Business at □□'s tavern has been slowing down, and he is worried...
commission.teyvatdelight.searching_for_s: □□ has been searching for a sword without success. She has decided to broaden her search...
advancements.teyvatdelight.all_commissio: Witnessed the many lives of this world.
advancements.teyvatdelight.measure_world: How High Is the Sky, How Deep Is the Earth...
advancements.teyvatdelight.searching_for: Searching in All Directions for a Sword
Witnessed □□'s story with the Unseen Razor.

config.teyvatdelight.title: Teyvat's Delight Settings
config.teyvatdelight.copy_pool_detail: Copies candidates and exclusions. This trade will no longer follow changes to the public pool.
config.teyvatdelight.defaults_detail: Restore global defaults? Files change only after saving; shops are unaffected.
config.teyvatdelight.discard_detail: The current draft has not been saved.
config.teyvatdelight.local_scope: Edits local settings only, not multiplayer servers.
config.teyvatdelight.save_scope: Saves to the local data pack without resetting rolls, limits or player records.
config.teyvatdelight.remote_disabled: Connected to a multiplayer server. Local editing cannot change its rules.
config.teyvatdelight.saved_reload_failed: Files saved, but reload failed: %s. Correct the issue and run /reload.
config.teyvatdelight.invalid_item: Enter a registered item ID (not air).
config.teyvatdelight.invalid_list: Too many entries or duplicate items; combine quantities for the same item.
config.teyvatdelight.invalid_source: Enter a valid item ID, #tag or existing public pool.
config.teyvatdelight.missing_sell: At least one fixed product is required.
config.teyvatdelight.missing_source: Set a source for random products.
config.teyvatdelight.name: Trade Name
config.teyvatdelight.title.tip: Text or translation key; empty uses the shop resource ID.
config.teyvatdelight.name.tip: Text or translation key; empty uses product names. Does not change the trade ID.
config.teyvatdelight.enabled.tip: Disables this shop or trade without deleting player history.
config.teyvatdelight.order.tip: Lower values appear first; ties use resource IDs.
config.teyvatdelight.refreshTime.tip: -1 inherits global, -2 never refreshes; 0..23999 is a day tick. 22000=04:00, 0=06:00.
config.teyvatdelight.commissionRefreshTi: 22000=04:00. 0 replaces a commission after claiming; unfinished ones do not auto-expire.
config.teyvatdelight.durationTicks.tip: -1 follows refresh, 0 never expires; positive ticks count running game time, 20 ticks ~ 1 second. New commissions only.
config.teyvatdelight.dailyCount.tip: 1..ordinary commission limit. Important and urgent commissions are additional.
config.teyvatdelight.limit.tip: 1..64. Important, reward-ready and claimed records do not occupy this limit.
config.teyvatdelight.selection.tip: Random selects by weight; rotation selects in order.
config.teyvatdelight.every.tip: 1..1000000. Existing milestone rewards remain; changes apply to the next cycle.
config.teyvatdelight.shopRefreshTime.tip: -1 follows commission refresh; 0..23999 is a day tick. Shops may override.
config.teyvatdelight.balanceItems.tip: 0..2 distinct item IDs. Empty hides balances without affecting prices.
config.teyvatdelight.firstChance.tip: 0..1; 0.7 means 70%. Failure stops enchanting; affects future rolls only.
config.teyvatdelight.chanceStep.tip: 0..1. Subtracted after each success; 0 disables reduction.
config.teyvatdelight.allowCurses.tip: Whether random equipment may receive legal curse enchantments.
config.teyvatdelight.countryChallengeWin: Grants the matching glider for nation food collection challenges.
config.teyvatdelight.primogemsInChests.t: Allows Primogems in this mod's added chest loot; Mora is unaffected.
config.teyvatdelight.type.tip: Fixed uses product lists; random uses a selection source. Switching retains the other draft settings.
config.teyvatdelight.dailyLimit.tip: -1 unlimited, 0 unavailable; positive values limit trades per player per cycle, not item quantities.
config.teyvatdelight.drawCount.tip: Draws per transaction; unique draws need enough candidates. Random rewards allow up to 16 draws.
config.teyvatdelight.count.tip: Actual item quantity, 1..1000000; not the number of draws.
config.teyvatdelight.randomCount.tip: Items delivered per random product draw, 1..64.
config.teyvatdelight.repeat.tip: Controls duplicates within a draw, not purchase limits.
config.teyvatdelight.enchantEquipment.ti: Random enchants use global probabilities and respect legal levels and compatibility.
config.teyvatdelight.item.tip: For example minecraft:apple or teyvatdelight:mora; not a translated name.
config.teyvatdelight.selector.tip: For example minecraft:apple or #minecraft:planks. Tag contents are checked in-world.
config.teyvatdelight.pool.tip: For example teyvatdelight:diamond_equipment. Referencing does not copy or change the pool.
config.teyvatdelight.weight.tip: Positive weight. 2 has roughly twice the selection chance of 1; not item quantity.
config.teyvatdelight.reward_reference.ti: For example teyvatdelight:commission. Uses the referenced reward without changing its file.
config.teyvatdelight.resource.tip: For example yourpack:travel_supplies; saving creates the matching shops JSON.
